response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_short_interest, AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_option_volume_ratio FROM transactionrecord tr INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist), baseline_by_order_type AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_short_interest) as baseline_short_interest FROM transaction_averages WHERE avg_short_interest IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ta.transreg, ta.ordertypedist, ta.avg_short_interest, ta.avg_option_volume_ratio, CASE WHEN ta.avg_short_interest IS NOT NULL AND b.baseline_short_interest IS NOT NULL THEN ta.avg_short_interest / b.baseline_short_interest ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM transaction_averages ta LEFT JOIN baseline_by_order_type b ON ta.ordertypedist = b.ordertypedist ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
